ns2:section.sectionText: This course is designed to prepare students to function effectively in a Japanese work environment by focusing both on practical language skills and on relevant cultural information. It should be particularly useful for students who intend to participate in an internship program in Japan or whose future career may require the ability to communicate smoothly and effectively with Japanese business people. Building on the skills and knowledge acquired in Workplace Japanese I, students will learn how to use higher level business-related language effectively and appropriately. Students will also learn about the Japanese business world, including the anime and video game industries, through level-appropriate readings in Japanese.
